landing.heroBody: Building telepathy at scale — where nothing is lost between what you think and what you do. We're seeking participants for data collection and testing in our San Francisco office.
landing.heroTagline: In-person, paid sessions in San Francisco.
landing.heroDescription: We build mind-reading AI to enable high-bandwidth, direct brain-to-computer communication. We gracefully automate tasks and keep humans in the loop
landing.heroCtaSecondary: Participant payment: $50 for a completed session
booking.infoBlock:
Location: Steiner & Haight Street, San Francisco, 94117

Speak and type responses to on-screen prompts while wearing a headset.

Participant Payment: $50 for a completed session, subject to Conduit’s payment procedures and the applicable consent form. The participant payment is for your time and inconvenience as a voluntary research participant. It is not wages, salary, or compensation for services.

If you bring a parking receipt from 1275 Fell St Parking, we’re happy to validate the cost of up to 3 hours of parking. This lot is only open from 8am–10pm, so please plan accordingly for early and late sessions.

Limits: 2 sessions back to back, 32 sessions per person.

Check-in: Bring a valid government-issued ID that matches your booking details.

Requirements: You must be at least 18 years old, be able to type on a computer keyboard without looking at it, and be able to sit still while wearing a tight, fairly heavy headset, similar to a motorcycle helmet, during the session.

Conduit may decline, reschedule, cancel, pause, or end a session before or during participation for eligibility, safety, scheduling, technical, facility-access, participant-conduct, or study-integrity reasons.

Further details are sent by email after the booking request is confirmed.
